newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: N.Korea's Jan-June foreign trade falls - Seoul.
newsitem.headline: N.Korea's Jan-June foreign trade falls - Seoul.

text.p: North Korea's foreign trade volume is estimated to have fallen 7.8 percent to $830 million during the first half of this year from $900 million a year earlier, South Korea's unification ministry said on Wednesday.
Pyongyang does not release its economic statistics. Seoul's unificiation ministry calculated its estimate based on material collected from a variety of sources, officials said.
Exports fell to $260 million from last year's $300 million and imports dipped five percent to $570 million from $600 million, a ministry report said.
Energy imports from China were estimated at $84 million during the six-month period, down from $97 million a year ago, a ministry official said.
He said China supplies most of North Korea's energy demand. But he gave no data on imports from other countries.
For all of this year, the communist state's foreign trade volume is expected to lag behind last year's $2.05 billion, the report said.
